snippet.title: Satellite Odyssey: Jupiter - PLAYTEST Trailer - Survival horror / Noire Detective / Sci-fi
snippet.description:
🎷Satellite Odyssey: Jupiter is a stylish blend of survival horror and noir detective mystery wrapped in a decopunk aesthetic. Rogue machines, mutant insects, and jazz echoing through deep space... Beautifully unsettling.

THE PLAYTEST WILL BEGIN IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS
👉 Sign up for the playtest on Steam:
